_note: The 25 idea categories in brain/ideas/seed-500.csv, each mapped to the nearest node in brain/taxonomy.md (a business-function taxonomy). node = null where a category is an industry, a sales channel or a product type rather than a business function, or spans several functions: those are listed in the gate report for Archie to place, not guessed. A test checks every node exists in brain/taxonomy.md.

Sales operations and bids.why: bids and quoting are a sales function

SME websites.why: a small firm's website is its marketing

Health, safety, quality and environment.why: H&S and quality are compliance duties; environment could arguably sit under ESG

Purchasing and supply chain.why: purchasing is procurement; supply chain could arguably sit under supply chain and logistics

Documents, data and IT admin.why: IT admin is the main part

Facilities, fleet and assets.why: facilities and assets; fleet could arguably sit under supply chain and logistics

Back-office automation.why: spans finance, HR and operations admin; no single node

Monitoring and alerts.why: a product type; what is monitored decides the function

Traditional industries.why: an industry group, not a business function

Professional services.why: an industry group, not a business function

Local consumer businesses.why: an industry group, not a business function

Property and construction.why: an industry, not the facilities function

E-commerce and marketplaces.why: a sales channel and industry; could be sales or operations

Digital products and content.why: a product type, not a business function

Agent-readiness for SMEs.why: new: making a firm usable by AI agents; no node yet

x402 utility tools.why: a sales channel (paid calls from AI agents), not a business function

x402 data APIs.why: a sales channel (paid calls from AI agents), not a business function
